subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should fresh, currently authorized MCP App views be allowed to request one consented plain-text user message through the existing Control UI chat-send path?
rationale: This deliberately expands what sandboxed app content may ask the host to do, and implementation correctness alone cannot decide whether OpenClaw accepts that trust boundary.

options.title: Approve Guarded Messaging
options.body: Accept the capability with current-run authority, read-only reconstruction, interaction checks, validation, rate limits, exact-text confirmation, and the existing send seam.

options.title: Keep Apps Read-Only
options.body: Retain the host-context and reconstruction improvements but remove app-originated chat-message support.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Messaging
recommendation.body: Accept the capability with current-run authority, read-only reconstruction, interaction checks, validation, rate limits, exact-text confirmation, and the existing send seam.

likelyOwner.reason: This assigned repository member owns the current implementation and documented boundary rationale, making them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
